title: ProductCompatibility
description: ISO 25010-sourced quality archetype — Compatibility product quality characteristic. Defines the property vocabulary for compatibility governance: co-existence with other products in shared environments and interoperability through information exchange. Rootless archetype — used as qualifier in Directives/Norms. Source: ISO/IEC 25010 (Product Quality — Compatibility: Co-existence, Interoperability).

coexistenceLevel.description: Degree of co-existence capability. ISOLATED = dedicated environment required. SHARED_RESOURCES = shares infrastructure but isolated data. SHARED_ENVIRONMENT = shares environment with managed contention. FULLY_COEXISTENT = no interference in any shared context.

interoperabilityLevel.description: Degree of interoperability. NONE = no exchange. DATA_EXCHANGE = raw data sharing. FUNCTIONAL_EXCHANGE = service-level integration. SEMANTIC_INTEROP = shared meaning and context.

standardProtocols.description: List of standard protocols or formats supported for interoperability (e.g., REST, GraphQL, gRPC, AMQP).

sharedResourceContention.description: Expected contention level when co-existing on shared resources (CPU, memory, network, storage).
